purpose: To advertise an application, petition or reference in Form NCLT-3A as required under the rules.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not less than fourteen days before the date fixed for hearing
steps: Check if the Tribunal or rules require the application, petition or reference to be advertised.
Publish the advertisement in Form NCLT-3A at least once in a vernacular newspaper and at least once in an English newspaper not less than fourteen days before the hearing.
Include the required details such as presentation date, names and addresses, nature of the petition, hearing date, and the statement regarding notices of opposition or support.
Place the advertisement on the company website if the company is giving the advertisement and has a website.
File an affidavit to the Tribunal not less than three days before the hearing stating that the petition was advertised and notices were served, accompanied by available proof.
checklist: Verify the date fixed for hearing.
Draft the advertisement in Form NCLT-3A containing the presentation date, names, addresses, nature of petition, hearing date, and the required statement for affected persons.
Arrange publication in a vernacular newspaper in the principal language of the company's registered office district.
Arrange publication in an English newspaper circulating in that district.
Prepare the affidavit stating that the petition has been advertised and notices duly served.
Gather proof of advertisement or service to accompany the affidavit.
watch: Non-compliance with advertisement and service rules may lead the Tribunal to dismiss the petition.
